pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark-brown regions with moderate edge angularity. The pixel gradients at the boundaries are relatively sharp, with patches occupying a dominant spatial area compared to the interstitial spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological lattice. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is variable, narrowing at the neck and widening across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. Individual hair bundles create a jagged 1D contour against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three avian organisms (Red-billed Oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal and lateral surfaces: one on the upper shoulder/neck region, one on the mid-flank, and one on the posterior rump area.
